laws.rule: City of Victoria Falls' published vending notice directs vendors to designated trading areas and says a valid trading licence is needed, even for trading from one's own premises/house. This is a Council explanatory/administrative notice, not a claim the underlying enacted bylaw was read. It does not concern ordinary tourists merely buying goods. The city separately lists bylaw documents, but full text/current amendments remain not yet checked.

sources.title: City of Victoria Falls vending notice, 23 September 2024
